Answer: B
Reason: The pre-operative image (Figure 1a) shows a large right-sided mass causing significant shift of the mediastinal structures (heart and trachea) to the left. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) demonstrates that while the mass has been removed, the heart and trachea remain shifted to the left, and the right lung appears only partially re-expanded compared to the left, likely due to residual space or incomplete expansion.
